minutes.headline: Select Board recommended the school override ballot question 3-2 and put it on the May 18 ballot; sick-leave article deferred.
minutes.summary: The board heard public comment on the school override, then each member stated a position on it before voting on warrant article recommendations. It approved a Hannaford manager change contingent on payment of a sewer bill, ratified a conservation hire, and opted out of early voting by mail. Several articles were deferred, one was removed, and the override question was voted onto the May 18 ballot by roll call.

what_happened.line: The Select Board recommended approval of the school override ballot question, article H, by a 3-2 vote.
A roll call vote to put the override question on the May 18 ballot was taken, but the result is not audible in the recording.
The board recommended the FY25 capital plan borrowing and the FY25 omnibus budget, each 5-0, and deferred the prior-year expenses and FY24 budget amendment articles.
The sick-leave article for new parents was deferred pending information on financial impact and union equity.
The board approved a change of manager for Hannaford's alcohol license, contingent on proof of sewer bill payment, and continued the hearing a week.

why_it_matters: The override question is the one that will change a tax bill if voters approve it, so the 3-2 recommendation is the board's signal ahead of the ballot, though the recording does not capture the final ballot vote.

Deferred and removed articles, including prior-year expenses, sick leave for new parents and additional real estate exemptions, will come back at a later town meeting, so what residents vote on this spring is narrower than the original warrant.
watch_next: The Select Board meets April 9, where the continued Hannaford hearing should confirm whether the sewer bill was paid.
The deferred sick-leave article and the exemptions article, which was sent to the November special town meeting.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on most votes and outcomes, and most figure differences are caption garbling of amounts the official minutes print in full. The one thing to know is that they differ on procedure for the Hannaford hearing (continued in ours, approved outright in the official) and for Article X (ours records a failed removal vote, the official records only an informal board consensus). Ours also lists an Article K recommendation and an override roll call with no recorded outcome.
